observations: Photo 0 shows two black rounded power banks lying on a concrete floor with a green and a blue braided USB cable.
The upper unit is wrapped almost entirely in masking tape, as if to hold the casing together.
The lower unit has strips of black tape on its face and heavy scratches; a small round logo near one end is not legible.
No capacity rating, label, charge indicator lights or ports can be read.
Neither unit is shown switched on or charging a device.
Phone watermark 'Shot on AWESOME A70' at the bottom; dim indoor light.

claims.evidence: Photo 0: both units are worn, taped and scratched, consistent with scrap.
No label, receipt or inside view; it also conflicts with the seller's own word 'scrap'.
No clip of either unit charging a phone or showing its charge level.
Photo 0: one unit is wrapped in masking tape and the other carries tape patches, signs the casings were opened or broken.

risks.risk: Units do not charge or hold charge at all.
risks.proof: Clip of each unit charging a phone with its indicator lights on.

risks.risk: Swollen or damaged lithium cells under the tape, a fire risk and lower scrap value.
risks.proof: Photo of each unit with the tape removed, side view on a flat surface.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as damaged cells, scrap only.

risks.risk: Cells removed or replaced with fewer or lower capacity cells.
risks.proof: Photo of the opened casing showing the cells and their markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as scrap casings with unknown cells.

risks.risk: Quantity is only the two units shown.
risks.proof: One photo showing every unit offered in the lot.

proof_requests: Clip of each power bank charging a phone with indicator lights on.
Photo of each unit with the tape removed, including a side view for swelling.
Photo of the labels showing brand and capacity.
One photo of the whole lot if more than two units are offered.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows two worn, taped power banks the seller calls scrap, so they can be priced at their worst case as two not working scrap units. The 'new battery' and 'never repaired' claims are unproven or contradicted by the tape and cannot raise the price.
